result.title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
result.summary: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

AI.brief_summary: 报告某全球银行创新实验室对十个 agentic AI 平台的产业化对比评测：跨职能小组在三个金融业务负载上按九个能力维度打分，区分出三层平台梯队，并发现各维度间 Cronbach's alpha 达 0.98、多数维度与总分的秩相关≥0.93 的晕轮效应，据此提出「先门控后打分」的四层评测协议与重复运行的可靠性指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其中关于评分晕轮、展示效果与真实能力混淆、以及多次重复运行估计可靠性并设门控层的做法，可能可供核查 latent 推理评价中如何区分真实推理贡献与表面呈现。
